This is the first standing Tier 2 scan since platform baseline (2026-05-09). Several items surfaced (China cross-border pathways, effective 2026-01-01/2026-07-01; Korea PIPA, effective 2026-09-11) have effective dates that already passed before this scan cycle existed. These are legitimately new to DataSafeguard's tracking (confirmed absent from baseline-state-of-the-world.md and gap-analysis.md) and are therefore alerted as catch-up/backlog items rather than forward-looking warnings — flagged explicitly in each alert's TIMELINE section.

UAE PDPL Executive Regulations status and South Africa Information Regulator enforcement posture could not be confirmed against a specific, dated, citable primary or credible secondary source this pass; both were downgraded to LOW-digest watch items rather than alerted, per the operating rules against alerting on unconfirmed/opinion-adjacent content. Recommend dedicated primary-source verification next cycle.
